behavior_constraints: Binary builds with `go build -o kvstore ./cmd/kvstore` from /app
Accepts --data-dir <path> flag (default ./data)
Reads commands from stdin one per line, writes results to stdout
PUT key value -> OK <seqnum> (value is trimmed remainder after key)
GET key -> value or NOT_FOUND
DELETE key -> OK <seqnum>
DELETE_RANGE start end -> OK <seqnum>
SCAN start end [--prefix p] [--limit N] [--reverse] -> key\tvalue lines, no tombstoned keys
FLUSH -> OK and forces MemTable to SSTable
COMPACT -> OK and triggers full compaction across all levels

instruction_head:

The engine must be accessible through a command-line interface that reads commands from stdin (one per line) and writes results to stdout.

behavior_constraints: PUT --ttl <seconds> sets key to expire that many seconds after write time (wall-clock Unix seconds)
GET on an expired key returns NOT_FOUND
SCAN excludes expired keys from results
Compaction may GC expired keys but must respect MVCC snapshot visibility — a snapshot taken before the expiration timestamp still sees the key
TTL <key> returns remaining seconds until expiration as an integer rounded down, -1 if the key has no TTL, or NOT_FOUND if the key does not exist
PUT without --ttl on a key that previously had a TTL clears the TTL
TX_PUT and BATCH PUT accept --ttl <seconds>
STATS includes expired_keys (count of keys whose TTL elapsed but not yet GC'd) and total_keys must exclude expired keys
WAL single entry format: expire_at (uint64 LE, Unix seconds, 0 = no expiration) immediately after seqnum
WAL batch op format: op (uint8) + expire_at (uint64 LE) + key_len (uint32 LE) + key + val_len (uint32 LE) + value
affected_prior: WAL (binary format change — AppendSingle/AppendBatch/Replay must read/write expire_at)
MemTable (PointEntry struct gains expire_at; Add/AllEntries/EntriesInRange/PrefixScan/RangeTombstones must filter or expose expiration)
SSTable / SSTableReader (data block entry format change adds expire_at after seqnum)
Engine (GET/SCAN/STATS/TTL command logic must account for expiration and MVCC visibility)
CLI main (PUT/TX_PUT/BATCH PUT parsing gains --ttl flag; new TTL command; STATS output changes)
entities.summary: Add TTL-based key expiration persisted in WAL and SSTables, with expired keys behaving as deleted across GET/SCAN/compaction, a new TTL command, --ttl support on PUT/TX_PUT/BATCH PUT, and STATS reporting expired_keys while excluding them from total_keys.

instruction_head:
I need key expiration support. Add a `--ttl <seconds>` flag to `PUT` — when set, the key expires after that many seconds from the time of the write (use wall-clock time). Expired keys behave exactly like deleted keys: `GET` returns `NOT_FOUND`, `SCAN` excludes them, and compaction can GC them (respecting MVCC snapshot visibility — a snapshot taken before expiration still sees the key).
